findings.source_quote: In Leviticus chapters 21 and 22, a plan, called a divorce, was put in place to legally dissolve the “first love”.

findings.translation_quote: 在利未记第21章和第22章中，人们制定了一项名为离婚的安排，以合法解除“初恋”。

findings.location: 第3个旧约例证（玛拉基书 2:14-16）
findings.source_quote: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit.
findings.suggested_fix: 将“上帝岂不是使二人成为一体吗？祂虽有余力能造许多人，却只造一人。”改为能保留原句含义的译文，例如：“他不是造了一个吗？然而他仍有灵的余力。”
findings.translation_quote: 上帝岂不是使二人成为一体吗？祂虽有余力能造许多人，却只造一人。

findings.location: 第3个旧约例证后的评论
findings.source_quote: men still try to cover it with a garment of civil, legal acceptance called "divorce".
findings.suggested_fix: 将“人们仍试图用一件名为‘离婚’的外衣——民事法律的认可——来掩盖这事。”改为“人们仍试图用名为‘离婚’的民事法律认可来掩盖这事。”
findings.translation_quote: 人们仍试图用一件名为“离婚”的外衣——民事法律的认可——来掩盖这事。

findings.source_quote: Jesus, when asked by the Pharisees about this issue, takes them back to original intent of His Father when He chides them…
findings.suggested_fix: 将“祂责备他们，并引他们回到天父起初的旨意上”改为“祂告诫他们，并引他们回到天父起初的旨意上”，避免把 chides 译成带有责备意味的“责备”。
findings.translation_quote: 祂责备他们，并引他们回到天父起初的旨意上……

findings.location: 哥林多前书 7:5 例外说明
findings.source_quote: So, restraining the marriage relationship for a time with voluntary consent from both husband and wife when there is a need for seeking God’s favor or guidance on a matter of great importance, may in some circumstances find God’s blessing.
findings.suggested_fix: 将“夫妻双方自愿同意暂时停止婚姻关系”改为“夫妻双方自愿同意暂时停止夫妻间的亲密关系”，避免把暂停夫妻亲密关系误译为暂停整个婚姻关系。
findings.translation_quote: 夫妻双方自愿同意暂时停止婚姻关系，在某些情况下或可蒙上帝赐福。

findings.source_quote: By Hosea patiently "alluring her and speaking comfortably to her" (2:19-20)

findings.translation_quote: 何西阿耐心地“诱导她，领她到旷野，对她说安慰的话”（2:19-20）

findings.location: 结尾段（马太福音 18:20 引文）
findings.source_quote: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them –Matthew 18:20.

findings.translation_quote: 因为无论在哪里，有两三个人奉我的名聚会，那里就有我在他们中间。——马太福音 18:20。
